messages:
Rae (PM): Quick sync: finalizing Playground streaming UI. Two hotspots: 'Freeze' vs 'Stop' wording, and where live token info should live.
Sam (Design): Suggestion: use 'Freeze' in full UI to imply non-destructive halt; compact shows a stop-square icon with aria label.
Priya (Frontend): Implementation note: toggling label at breakpoint is fine, but it must not change keyboard shortcut behavior.
Diego (Eng): Backend: abort vs rerun are separate ops. We can support a toggle in UI; regen will need a prefix reset flag. We'll also emit token ticks at 300ms.
Maya (A11y): Accessibility needs: dynamic label updates must update aria-label. Announce end-of-stream with aria-live region: 'Generation finished' or 'Generation frozen by user'.
Sam (Design): Token placement idea: show live mini-gutter counter to the left of the message while streaming; after finish, move a final badge to the message timestamp. On mobile, always keep the badge inline.
Priya (Frontend): We'll throttle client updates to 500ms and animate numbers unless prefers-reduced-motion. Make token counter role=status so SRs pick it up but keep it out of tab order.
Rae (PM): Copy: research leaned toward 'Regenerate' for re-run action. For the halt action choose either 'Freeze' or 'Stop'  which do we prefer?
Sam (Design): I prefer 'Freeze' semantically. Visual: pill with icon+text in full, icon-only in compact + tooltip.
Diego (Eng): Edge case: regen while another regen queued -> server returns 429. Client should show spinner in pill and disable extra clicks.
Priya (Frontend): Pseudocode: stream.on('token', n => throttled(500, () => setToken(n))). Tooltip uses aria-describedby for keyboard users.
Maya (A11y): Ensure contrast for badge text >=4.5:1 and announce 'Token usage: N tokens' via polite live region.
Rae (PM): Decisions: Use 'Freeze' in full, icon-only stop in compact with aria label. Live gutter token during stream, final badge after. Throttle 500ms, respect reduced-motion. Regen pinned to prompt selection.
Sam (Design): +1, will update mocks.
Priya (Frontend): +1, will prototype and add aria-live.
Diego (Eng): +1, will add regen rate-limit notes to API doc.
Maya (A11y): +1, will run SR check on prototype.
CI Bot: Build 5230 queued for branch playground/freeze-token-gutter  unit tests running.
Rae (PM): Thanks  follow-ups: Sam mock, Priya prototype, Diego API, Maya SR pass.
